summary: Core 9 moves to net10.0 and introduces workflow-instance table conversion plus a draft/published workflow queue setting.

notes: Update all projects to net10.0 before restoring.
Update build-pipeline-api.yml netVersion to 10.0 when present.
Update Azure App Service runtime to .NET 10.

After deployment, run ConvertWorkflowInstanceJsonConfigToTables or the Workflow Cycle tab will not render.
